name: DPW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Crowned in an eight-man tournament at the federation's 2003 reopening and defended almost every week through the spring of 2004, until its own Prodigy stable turned on its first champion to take it.

name: DPW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Crowned in a tag tournament at the federation's first New Year's card and, after an unrecorded change of hands, won again by the Wolfpack3000's own Mongs, who held it through the spring of 2004.

name: DPW Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Created to crown the winner of the federation's first Royal Rumble and defended through the spring of 2004, changing hands twice on record and at least once more off the record.

name: DPW Women's Championship
epitaph: Created in the winter of 2004-05 for the federation's small but growing women's roster and won outright by its first challenger.

name: DPW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own top prize in its earlier run, changing hands when the challenger's own ally pulled the champion's legs from under him mid-move.

name: DPW Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Defended in a falls-count-anywhere match the champion's own pet donkey helped him win.

name: DPW U.S. Championship
epitaph: Retained against a debuting challenger left burned in the face by an exploding gift box.
